architecture_note: Publication and evidence-presentation standard only. Not a new CC-PRIN-*, not a Phase 8/9 platform build, and not permission to invent statistics.
governing_rules: When reliable data exist, show them. Do not merely cite them in the background. Put the evidence where the reader encounters the theory.

DATA-DENSE BY DEFAULT. Every substantive public theory, doctrine, proof, and policy surface should use the maximum amount of relevant, high-quality, comprehensible real-world data available without creating false precision, cherry-picking, or unnecessary visual clutter.
Every displayed statistic must be traceable to a canonical data asset, observation period, geography, definition, and primary source whenever available.
Never add a statistic merely because it sounds persuasive. Every number must advance understanding.
Show contradictions and counterevidence on the page, not only favorable statistics.
Dense does not mean cluttered: use progressive disclosure.
prose_rule: Prefer numerically specific prose that names measures, geographies, and comparisons, then explains why they matter. Do not decorate rhetoric with orphan statistics.
public_reasoning_extension: Public Reasoning records that reverse or qualify empirical claims should include the data that forced the change (burdens, distributions, dependencies, counterevidence), not only narrative.

geography_ambition.note: Populate dynamically only from validated RedDirt/CC data assets. Do not invent county values.

cross_domain_display.goal: Show related indicators together so readers see a system, not isolated charts.
cross_domain_display.caution: Related indicators are not automatically causal. Label association vs causation.

data_binding_rule.forbid: hardcoded orphan percentages with no canonical lineage
data_binding_rule.engine: RedDirt public-statistics bridge + CC import lane; CC never holds agency credentials

explicitly_not_authorized: Baseline scoreboard inflation from display scaffolding alone
